meta.title: 教学合集｜自由泳滚翻技巧
meta.title_en: Freestyle Tumble Turn in Five Beats

scenes.context: 最后一把划水完成后，双臂迅速收拢贴在躯干两侧不再外划。这一动作减少水阻，为向前翻滚腾出旋转空间，是游进到转身的过渡信号。
sentences: 最后一把划水完成后，双臂贴紧身体不动。
After the final pull, pin both arms tight to your sides.
pin（贴紧）
收臂减少水阻，为翻滚腾出旋转空间。
Arms in reduce drag and make room for the roll.
drag（水阻）
这是从游进到转身的过渡信号。
It signals the shift from swimming to turning.
transition（过渡）
scenes.speak: After the final pull, pin both arms tight to your sides. Arms in reduce drag and make room for the roll. It signals the shift from swimming to turning.

scenes.context: 三个连续的身体指令：手下摆、眼睛看脚尖、头去找膝盖。身体折叠成紧凑的球状，这是翻滚半径最小的关键姿势。
sentences: 手下摆，眼睛看脚尖，头去找膝盖。
Hands sweep down, eyes on your toes, head reaching for your knees.
tuck（蜷体）
身体折叠成紧凑的球状，翻滚半径最小。
Fold into a tight ball for the smallest turning radius.
turning radius（翻滚半径）
这是关键姿势，头找膝盖让转动更快。
Head-to-knee is the key for a faster spin.
spin（转动）
scenes.speak: Hands sweep down, eyes on your toes, head reaching for your knees. Fold into a tight ball for the smallest turning radius. Head-to-knee is the key for a faster spin.

scenes.context: 身体从蜷曲球状开始向前下方翻滚旋转，翻滚动量在此刻积累，为触壁蹬出做准备。
sentences: 身体从蜷曲球状开始向前下方翻滚。
From the tucked ball, roll forward and downward.
roll（翻滚）
翻滚动量在此刻积累，为蹬壁做准备。
Momentum builds here, readying the push-off.
momentum（动量）
scenes.speak: From the tucked ball, roll forward and downward. Momentum builds here, readying the push-off.

scenes.title_cn: 第四拍：腰背打直流线蹬出
scenes.context: 翻滚完成后身体迅速伸展：腰背绷直、双臂向前伸直夹紧在头部两侧，进入蹬壁前的流线型预备姿态。画面与口播都强调：不要转动躯干直接蹬出。
sentences: 腰背打直，手伸直加紧在头部两侧。
Straighten your back, arms extended and squeezed by your head.
straighten（打直）
注意这个时候不要转动躯干直接蹬出。
Don't twist your trunk—push off straight away.
push off（蹬壁）
滑行时再转体，保持流线型获得最大距离。
Rotate only while gliding to keep the streamline and gain distance.
streamline（流线型）
scenes.speak: Straighten your back, arms extended and squeezed by your head. Don't twist your trunk—push off straight away. Rotate only while gliding to keep the streamline and gain distance.

scenes.title_cn: 关键认知：蹬壁≠立刻转体
scenes.title_en: The Mindset Shift: Push Off Straight
scenes.context: 全片最关键提醒：蹬壁时不要提前转躯干，保持流线型直接蹬出，滑行一段后再转体恢复划水。这一认知可能是这个11秒视频最有价值的单点提醒。
sentences: 蹬壁时保持流线型直接滑行，不要提前转体。
Push off streamlined and glide before you rotate.
glide（滑行）
滑行一段后再转体恢复划水。
Rotate to resume swimming only after a moment of glide.
resume（恢复）
把「蹬壁=立刻转回游进方向」变成「蹬壁=流线滑行再转」。
Change 'push off = turn now' into 'push off = glide, then turn'.
mindset shift（认知转变）
scenes.speak: Push off streamlined and glide before you rotate. Rotate to resume swimming only after a moment of glide. Change 'push off = turn now' into 'push off = glide, then turn'.

practice: After the final pull, pin both arms tight to your sides.
Hands sweep down, eyes on your toes, head reaching for your knees.
Roll forward and downward, loading momentum for the push.
Straighten your back, arms squeezed, and push off straight.
Don't twist your trunk—push off streamlined and rotate while gliding.
pitfalls: Rotating the trunk at the push-off.
Push off streamlined; rotate only during the glide.
蹬壁时不要提前转躯干。
Keeping arms wide during the roll.
Pinned arms reduce drag and give room to rotate.
Head-to-knee is the tightest, fastest rolling shape.
头找膝盖是翻滚半径最小的姿势。
Trying the tight roll before you can flip safely.
Practice in shallow water or with a coach first.
初学者先分步练习翻滚再衔接蹬壁。
Whisper misheard 躯干 (trunk) as 膝盖 (knee) — it's the trunk.
字幕「膝盖」是「躯干」的误识。
shifts: 用 tumble turn（翻滚转身）、tuck（蜷体）、streamline（流线型）
用 five-beat sequence（五拍口诀）、delayed rotation（延迟转体）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录口播与理性分析SVG。已校正：自由泳滚翻五拍为收臂贴紧、收下巴蜷体（手下摆眼睛看脚尖头去找膝盖）、蓄力转身、腰背打直蹬壁、流线滑行再转体、全片最关键提醒是蹬壁时不要转动躯干直接蹬出滑行时再转、Whisper将「躯干」误识为「膝盖」、内容标注来源于国外网站非原创教学、视频仅11秒无分步练习方法、初学者建议浅水区或教练陪同下分步练习等。
